description: Polyphonic sample and hold with track and hold and pass and hold modes, an internal noise source, and probability, level and offset controls

params.text: S samples the input on each rising trigger edge and holds it; T follows the input while the trigger is high and holds when it falls; P follows while the trigger is low and holds while it is high
Sets how likely a trigger is to take a sample, 0% to 100%
Attenuverts the voltage at the probability CV input, -100% to +100%, before it is added to the PROB. setting
Attenuates the input before it is sampled, 0% to 100%, across every channel
Adds a constant to the signal before the sample is taken, -10V to +10V; with a cable in the offset CV input it attenuverts that voltage instead

inputs.text: The signal that is sampled and held; with nothing patched, an internal noise source running from -5V to +5V is used instead
Drives the sampling, counting anything crossing 2V as high; nothing is produced until a cable is patched here, and the greater of this jack's channel count and INPUT's sets the output count
Picks the hold mode by voltage for every channel at once and takes the MODE switch out of circuit: under 2V gives S, 2V to 4V gives T, 4V and over gives P
Shifts how likely a trigger is to take a sample, added to the PROB. setting; a single channel here applies to every trigger channel
Shifts the signal before the sample is taken, scaled by the OFFSET knob; a single channel here applies to every output channel

outputs.text: Carries the held value, limited to -12V to +12V
Carries the held value with its sign flipped
